explanation: The divine Son who is perfect and Lord over the house, greater than Moses because he built the house.
A faithful servant in God's entire household who testified about things that were to be spoken later.
The divine community or church where God is the owner and Jesus is the builder.
The term describing the faithful attitude Moses had, but also the requirement placed on disciples to hold fast to their confidence.
The act of turning away from God's word or losing one's original confidence and hope.
The inner disposition of a person, which can become hardened through sinful desires or remain soft through faith.
The destructive power that prevents people from entering God's rest and leads to falling away.
The divine promise of peace and fulfillment that God gave, but which many did not receive due to unbelief.
